nodes.label: Goal-Driven Execution Principle
nodes.rationale: Transform tasks into verifiable success criteria and loop until verified rather than relying on vague goals.

nodes.label: Simplicity First Principle
nodes.rationale: Write the minimum code that solves the problem without speculative features, single-use abstractions, or impossible-scenario error handling.

nodes.label: Surgical Changes Principle
nodes.rationale: Modify only what traces directly to the request; preserve unrelated code and clean up only newly orphaned symbols.

nodes.label: Think Before Coding Principle
nodes.rationale: Surface assumptions, interpretations, and tradeoffs explicitly before coding to avoid silent misinterpretations.

nodes.label: Registration Intake (POST /api/registrations & receive-registration)
nodes.rationale: Recomputes integer rupiah price/DP on server, returns 409 on offer changes, enforces rate limits, and handles idempotent retries.

nodes.label: RPC receive_registration(batch, expected_price, participant, consent)
nodes.rationale: SECURITY INVOKER RPC restricted to service_role; returns received, duplicate, changed, or unavailable and enforces unique (batch_slug, email).

nodes.label: Registration HTTP Error Recovery (200/409/422/429/503)
nodes.rationale: Preserves form state in memory across recoverable failures and distinguishes 409 offer changes from 422 validation errors.

nodes.label: payments Table Verification Status
nodes.rationale: Tracks pending/verified/rejected with reviewed_by and reviewed_at while keeping proof_object_key null for WhatsApp-based proof inspection.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Proof & Admin ID Verification
nodes.rationale: Transfer proofs are not uploaded to the app; receipt provides a prefilled WhatsApp link (0857-1779-7637) with registration ID for admin matching.

nodes.label: Series 4-Session Weekly Schedule Helper

nodes.label: batches.sessions JSONB Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: batches.sessions jsonb single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Relational sessions table is unused by the batch flow; storing WIB sessions in batches.sessions JSONB validated by valid_session_schedule avoids dual writes.

nodes.label: Seven Visitor Priorities Structure

nodes.rationale: Consolidated navigation into one collapsible group/sub-menu sidebar while keeping a 72px header solely for logo, theme toggle, and user menu so cursors do not travel back and forth across two screen edges.

nodes.label: Data First, Decoration Never Principle
nodes.rationale: Admin CMS serves internal operators and writers rather than visitors, so layout and color exist strictly for action, status, and one soft accent per area without decorative clutter.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Transfer Proof & Manual Verification Workflow
nodes.norm_label: whatsapp transfer proof & manual verification workflow
nodes.rationale: Payment proofs are never uploaded to app storage; registrants send transfer proof to official admin WhatsApp 0857-1779-7637 with prefilled ID, and admins manually verify against invoice status pending/verified/rejected because opening wa.me does not prove delivery.

nodes.label: Monochrome Soft Design System (--admin-* Tokens)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the Blue Soft UI visual direction on 16 Nov 2026: white canvas, monochrome ink/surface hierarchy, five soft semantic tones (mint, peach, rose, butter, lilac) restricted to chips/dots/charts/errors, Plus Jakarta Sans 300-600, and no blue except the Albana logo.

nodes.label: Public Academy vs Admin CMS Channel Divergence
nodes.norm_label: public academy vs admin cms channel divergence
nodes.rationale: Public Academy uses editorial geometry (radius 0 frames, line-style forms, Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter, #26599A blue, scroll storytelling motion), while since 16 Nov 2026 Admin CMS intentionally uses Monochrome Soft and shares only the logo and accessibility rules.

nodes.label: Staged Verification & Handoff Protocol
nodes.rationale: Constrains multi-chat LLM execution to one stage at a time with read-only checkout/DB verification before edits, explicit no-go gates, and structured handoff summaries to prevent unverified assumptions.

nodes.label: Bidirectional Form-End Bundle Offer (Speaker <-> Certification)
nodes.rationale: Option C chosen over a 4th landing program or pre-form selectors: keeps landing page at 3 Public Training programs, offers the Rp2.900.000 package at the end of /register/[program] in both directions only when both programs have open batches, defaults to unselected, and includes BNSP non-guarantee disclaimer.

nodes.label: Program as Single Source of Price, DP & Form Kind
nodes.norm_label: program as single source of price, dp & form kind
nodes.rationale: Because admins rarely edit the 4 fixed programs and routinely open new batches, moving price_idr, original_price_idr, dp_percent, fee_details, and form_kind onto programs reduces batch creation to just batch name, WIB session dates, and an open toggle.

nodes.label: Motion Tooling Division (CSS vs motion/react vs GSAP/Lenis)
nodes.norm_label: motion tooling division (css vs motion/react vs gsap/lenis)
nodes.rationale: Assigns one tool per effect: CSS transitions/keyframes for hover and skeleton sheen, motion/react LazyMotion (domMax) for DOM enter/exit/layoutId/drag in admin and dialogs, and GSAP + ScrollTrigger + Lenis exclusively for homepage scroll.

nodes.label: Supabase-Retention Release Strategy
nodes.rationale: Defers MariaDB migration from the 13 Nov plan and retains Supabase project clgjsekfnexmanjdxmqy through Phase 8 Hostinger deployment, focusing first on broken legacy table references, bank accounts, registration E2E, Monochrome Soft UI, and release gates.

nodes.label: Admin Form Standardization (controls.tsx & Single Header)
nodes.rationale: Eliminates three competing admin input styles (admin-form-plain, InputLine/SelectLine, custom inline classes) and unlayered CSS overrides by routing all active admin forms through controls.tsx wrappers over shadcn/ui and enforcing a single shell header per form page.

nodes.label: Program Documentation Gallery (10-20 Photos, 1-2 YouTube)
nodes.rationale: Removes standalone /admin/media CMS and moves photo/video management into ProgramForm section 2 (replacing Formulir pendaftaran), preserving media_assets, WebP compression in /api/upload, and /api/media/[id] signed URLs while enforcing upper limits server-side and treating lower counts as warnings.

nodes.label: Hostinger Unlimited Hosting Constraints
nodes.rationale: Shared Unlimited Web Hosting lacks VPS, root SSH, and FFmpeg transcoding, and overwrites hbuilds/public_html on redeploy; thus videos must use YouTube or pre-compressed MP4 <=25 MiB (720p min) and images are compressed server-side with Sharp from <=10 MiB to <=5 MiB.

nodes.label: Release No-Go & Rollback Gates
nodes.rationale: Blocks cutover if registration is non-atomic, invoices can duplicate or collide on unique codes, private data leaks, admin login fails, media disappears on redeploy, or QA fails; mandates delta reconciliation before rollback after live writes.

nodes.label: Safe Legacy Removal & Verification Gates
nodes.rationale: Prevents premature deletion of Panggung Kreator subsystems by requiring replacement verification, full import/route/URL/DB reference audits, and small per-subsystem commits with typecheck/lint/build/smoke verification.

nodes.label: REGISTRATION_STEPS & Step Validation Gate
nodes.rationale: Splits registration into four validated steps (identity, background, technical, payment) so invalid steps block advancement while preserving values when navigating back.

nodes.label: RLS + Column-Level Grants Security Model
nodes.rationale: Requires both table/column GRANT and RLS policy for row access; testimonials and media_assets restrict anon SELECT to specific safe columns.

nodes.label: admin_users Allowlist Table
nodes.rationale: Sole source of truth for admin access (admin or adminsuper) after the legacy members table was dropped.

nodes.label: requireAdminMember() Auth Guard
nodes.rationale: Checks admin_users allowlist once per request via React cache() across admin layouts, pages, and server actions; legacy admin-auth.ts is unused by active CMS routes.

nodes.label: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY Rotation Requirement
nodes.rationale: The service role key bypasses RLS and was previously stored with a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, creating a full database exposure risk unless rotated before release.

nodes.label: Release Gates & Open Blockers
nodes.rationale: Launch requires creating the bank account CMS screen and active bank_accounts row, updating /admin/pendaftar to read academy_registrations, rotating the service role key, passing mobile E2E full/DP tests, resolving security advisor warnings, and achieving a clean production build.

nodes.label: Two-Column Registration & Manual Payment Confirmation Layout
nodes.norm_label: two-column registration & manual payment confirmation layout

nodes.label: Manual Bank Transfer Billing Flow
nodes.rationale: Generates invoices with subtotal plus a non-colliding unique code per bank account, with proof sent via WhatsApp and verified manually by admin in /admin/tagihan instead of integrating an automated payment gateway.

nodes.label: Media Upload & Dual Storage Pipeline (/api/upload & /api/media/[id])
nodes.rationale: Enforces admin auth and type/size/resolution limits, processes images via Sharp, stores program media drafts privately in media_assets (served via signed redirect for published assets or admins), and places purpose=landing assets in public gallery bucket.

nodes.norm_label: media hd minimum upload & auto-compression spec

nodes.rationale: Replaces initial-step bundle selection and pre-checkout review; displays a single radio card defaulting to No right before payment method on Speaker and Sertifikasi forms, recalculated server-side into one registration with two batch items.

nodes.label: receive_registration RPC Contract
nodes.rationale: Server rate-limits, validates inputs and consent, then invokes RPC with server credentials to verify batch availability and price atomically before saving registration.

nodes.rationale: Renders program curriculum, batch schedules, pricing, and conditional CTAs based on accepting_registrations.

nodes.label: Single-Panel Square Underline Registration UI
nodes.rationale: Uses a centered square panel without site header/footer, shadow, or theme switcher, with Inter/Montserrat typography and underlined inputs.

nodes.community_name: Contact Channels vs Bank Accounts Separa
nodes.norm_label: contact channels vs bank accounts separation
nodes.rationale: Separates published public contact channels from bank account records so visitors cannot read bank or participant records via API.

nodes.label: HD Media Compression Rule
nodes.rationale: Requires compressing backend images and videos without sacrificing HD quality in order to save storage.

nodes.label: Anti-Slop Content & Visual Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Prohibits cliché hype copy, unverified statistics/testimonials, emoji icons, purple/pink gradients, and multi-CTA clutter.

nodes.label: Reschedule-Allowed No-Refund Policy

nodes.norm_label: four fixed programs & lightweight batch model
nodes.rationale: Consolidates pricing, DP percentage, cost breakdown, and form copy onto four fixed programs so Program is the single source of truth for price while Batch only stores name, session schedule, and open toggle.

nodes.label: Albana Speech Academy
nodes.rationale: Vision: become a trusted partner in developing professional communication competence and competitive HR leadership. Mission: deliver communication training from basic to advance, improve self-confidence and communication performance, provide real-practice-based training, and support professional communication culture in organizations.

nodes.label: 70:20:10 Learning Model
nodes.rationale: Training delivery balance allocating 70% to Experiential Learning (direct practice, stage simulation, MC/Speaker role play, real case presentation), 20% to Coaching & Feedback (individual performance evaluation, peer review, trainer feedback), and 10% to Concept & Framework (professional communication theory, speaking framework structure, practical communication tools).

nodes.label: Communication Development Framework
nodes.rationale: Four-tier competence progression: Fundamental (Build Confidence), Professional (Effective Communication), Advance (Stage Performance), and Expert (Speaker & Facilitator).

nodes.label: Database-Enforced Registration & Billing Invariants
nodes.rationale: Price/DP snapshots, idempotency_key + submission_hash, unique code (1-999) per pending bank account, one invoice per stage (initial/remaining), and single active batch per program are enforced in PostgreSQL rather than app code.

nodes.label: Payment Gateway Analysis (Manual Transfer vs Mayar.id vs Xendit/Midtrans)
nodes.norm_label: payment gateway analysis (manual transfer vs mayar.id vs xendit/midtrans)
nodes.rationale: Manual transfer has zero transaction fees for Phase 1; Mayar.id Starter offers lightweight individual KYC but charges 1.5-4% platform fee above channel fee, breaking even against direct gateway integration around ~1.1-1.5 years.

nodes.label: Active Redesign & Restructure Implementation Plan (2026-11-16)
nodes.rationale: Active 9-phase work order covering database, registration, admin, landing page, cleanup, QA, and release; supersedes the 2026-11-13 revision plan.
